name: mirage
text: Yes, I can see them (your phone sent its report at 00:51 UTC). Four hand bets showed 'Novig FILLED this order but its fills could not be read yet (Novig is limiting how fast this account reads)': Portland +3.5 (154 contracts), Over 225.5 (152), Over 229.5 (95) and Over 57.5 (77). So the bets WERE placed at Novig. The error is only that the phone could not read the fill back, because Novig's read limit on the subaccount was used up, so the bets stay off your list for now. The fix on your side: Tracker > Sync with Novig (wait about a minute first) and they will appear. The cause is that the phone and the GitHub engine share the same read allowance and the phone was also scanning. I'll make the phone back off its scans while it confirms a hand bet's fill and retry the fill read, so this stops showing as an error. I'll tell you when that's shipped.
